title: Get Substring - Extract Text
description: Use Get Substring to extract portions of text by position.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "Error codes follow format 'ERR-SYSTEM-NUMBER': 'ERR-NAV-101'. We need to extract just the system code (middle part). Get Substring extracts text by character position."
story.context: Get Substring extracts text ranges—first N characters, last N characters, or specific ranges. Essential for parsing fixed-format data.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Perfect! You extracted the system code 'NAV' from the error code. Position-based extraction works great for structured text."

instructions: Create *** Settings *** section with Library    String
hints: Get Substring syntax: text    start_index    end_index
Start index inclusive, end index exclusive
Omit end_index to get substring to end
Negative index counts from end: -3 = last 3 chars
solution:
*** Settings ***
Library    String

*** Test Cases ***
Extract Error Components
    ${error_code}=    Set Variable    ERR-NAV-101
    Log    Full error: ${error_code}
    ${prefix}=    Get Substring    ${error_code}    0    3
    Log    Prefix: ${prefix}
    Should Be Equal    ${prefix}    ERR
    ${system}=    Get Substring    ${error_code}    4    7
    Log    System: ${system}
    Should Be Equal    ${system}    NAV
    ${number}=    Get Substring    ${error_code}    8
    Log    Number: ${number}
    Should Be Equal    ${number}    101

theory.title: Exercise 4.2.4: Get Substring
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Not all data is delimited. Sometimes it's positional—character 0-5 is date, 6-10 is time, 11+ is message. Get Substring extracts by position, perfect for fixed-format data."

Get Substring

Extract text by character position:

Library    String

${text}=    Set Variable    ABCDEFGH

# First 3 chars
${first}=    Get Substring    ${text}    0    3
# Result: 'ABC'

# Middle chars (index 3-5)
${mid}=    Get Substring    ${text}    3    6
# Result: 'DEF'

# From index 5 to end
${end}=    Get Substring    ${text}    5
# Result: 'FGH'

# Last 2 chars
${last}=    Get Substring    ${text}    -2
# Result: 'GH'

Indexing Rules:

  • Zero-based (first char = index 0)
  • Start inclusive, end exclusive
  • Negative index from end (-1 = last char)
  • Omit end = substring to string end

Example: Parse Fixed-Width Log

*** Settings ***
Library    String

*** Test Cases ***
Parse Log Line
    ${log}=    Set Variable    20251004143015ERRORSystem failure
    ${date}=    Get Substring    ${log}    0    8
    ${time}=    Get Substring    ${log}    8    14
    ${level}=    Get Substring    ${log}    14    19
    ${message}=    Get Substring    ${log}    19
    Log    ${date} ${time} [${level}] ${message}

⚠️ Get Substring Tips

  • Use for fixed-format data (non-delimited)
  • Combine with Get Length to validate format
  • Negative index for "last N characters"
  • Index out of range returns partial/empty string
  • For delimited data, use Split String instead
